name: Open Y AddThis
description: Provides a configurable block with social icons and links to share content using the AddThis service.
project_description:
🇺🇦 
 
 This module is maintained by Ukrainian developers.

Please consider supporting Ukraine in a fight for their freedom and safety of Europe. 
 
 
 AddThis services have been deprecated as of 5/31/23

 
 We recommend using AddToAny Share Buttons instead.

 
 Read our instructions for getting started . 
 Search our documentation for assistance. 
 Review our Community Resources for more information. 
 
 Requirements 
 This project is meant to be used with the YMCA's Website Service distribution .
